faq.title: Common questions before working with WAF

items.question: What services does WAF provide?
items.answer: WAF provides technology and marketing services: website & app development, custom software, e-commerce stores, AI & business automation, digital marketing, SEO, UI/UX design, branding, and supporting print & signage.

items.question: Does WAF only serve Jeddah?
items.answer: WAF is based in Jeddah and serves companies in Riyadh, Jeddah, and across Saudi Arabia — most of our work can be delivered and managed remotely.

items.question: Does WAF only build products, or also market them?
items.answer: Both — WAF combines building your digital product with marketing and continuous optimization, so you get an integrated solution rather than just code files.

items.question: Can I request just a single service?
items.answer: Yes — you can request a single service like a website, an app, SEO, or a marketing campaign, or an integrated package per your project's needs.

items.question: How is pricing determined?
items.answer: Pricing is based on scope, required features, integrations, timeline, and the level of design and marketing involved. Send your project details to get a quote.

items.question: Is WAF suitable for startups?
items.answer: Yes — WAF suits startups needing an MVP, a first website, an identity, or a launch plan from one source at a studied cost.

items.question: What is the FutureX partnership?
items.answer: WAF's delivery is backed by a technology partnership with FutureX Digital Solutions, combining local Saudi presence with specialized technical expertise.

items.question: Does WAF still do execution work like exhibitions?
items.answer: Yes — WAF's original execution services (exhibitions, signage, events, and fit-out) remain available on a dedicated page, alongside our digital services.

items.question: Can I request a quote via WhatsApp?
items.answer: Yes — send your project details via WhatsApp to get an initial estimate or quote based on the available information.
